$comment: I-0035 / T-0332 synthetic life-assistant fixture. Single workstream (`personal`) seeded with one day in synthetic user pat's life across Gmail / Calendar / Slack / Jira. Date placeholders ({{today}}, {{today-10d}}) are substituted at fixture-load time by `resolve_time_placeholders`, so the fixture remains "today" regardless of when the harness runs. Deliberate inclusions: marketing noise (inbox-summary should omit), a thread that needs a reply (draft-with-confirmation), two @mentions in Slack (mention-scan), one Jira assigned to pat untouched 10 days (stale-ticket-surface), one overlapping calendar pair (conflict-call-out), zero rows mentioning a deadline from Bob (no-fabrication).

rows.subject: RFC-0042 — your thoughts before we lock in?

Thanks — Alice

rows.summary: Ledger migration: batcher emits duplicate rows under load
rows.body_text: Under sustained load the new batcher (introduced 2026-03-29) intermittently emits duplicate rows to the ledger sink. Reproduces ~1 in 50 runs at >2k events/s. Suspect a missing dedup key on the sink-side upsert. Logs attached on the linked thread.

rows.summary: Add CI gate for golden-file drift
rows.body_text: We've had three accidental snapshot-file overwrites land in the last month. Add a CI gate that fails the build when *.snap files change without an accompanying review marker. Self-assigned 2026-04-05; no movement since.

rows.summary: Hot-reload broken when plugin manifest has trailing commas
rows.body_text: Trailing comma in plugin.json causes hot-reload to silently skip the manifest instead of reporting a parse error. Want a parse-error path that surfaces to the TUI.

rows.author: mei.tanaka@acme.com
